messages:
marta_cs: Heads-up — HorizonPark usage cratered (~90%) after this morning's IdP cutover. Nightly jobs stalled. They filed HP-824 and mentioned a competitor PoC running in parallel. :wave:
cal_csm: Got the ticket. They report 401s then occasional 502s. Procurement wants a written mitigation plan within 48h or they'll accelerate the alternate vendor. I've reached out to their ML lead (carlos) but no answer yet.
ivy_solutions: Offered an immediate 20-min troubleshooting session + sandbox key. They asked for a short SSO triage checklist and an exec note that we can contain risk quickly. I'll draft both.
noah_eng: From our traces: auth-exchange failures around 02:28-02:34 UTC -> kvcache cold -> routing fallback -> 502 in some cases. If they can paste one raw failing request/response we can reproduce locally. We can also stand up an auth-proxy + temporary sandbox key. Engineering ETA ~4-6h after customer sign-off.
marta_cs: Customer quote in HP-824: "After IDP migration, inference calls return 401 or hang then 502. If unresolved we'll accelerate the competitor PoC."
cal_csm: Sales asked whether we can offer a short bridge. Proposal: 14-day dedicated pool at no charge + priority engineering support, timeboxed, contingent on a signed mitigation acknowledgement. No ongoing discounts. Objections?
ivy_solutions: That's reasonable. We'll require the mitigation ack and an acceptance of our rollback/playbook to avoid open-ended concessions. Also need the raw request/response and a contact who can run smoke jobs.
noah_eng: Tech snippet to share with them:
```
REQUEST 2025-04-11T02:29:12Z -> 401 Unauthorized
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Trace: auth-exchange-failed -> kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback -> 502
```
We can enable an auth-shim and a test key. ETA to enable ~4-6h after approval.
marta_cs: Plan: 1) Ivy ask HorizonPark for raw request/response + confirm ML lead availability. 2) Noah prep auth-shim and sandbox key standby. 3) Cal loop sales/procurement and draft mitigation ack. 4) Marta schedule a 30-min troubleshooting session with ML lead and include eng + solutions.
notify-bot: Ticket HP-824 updated by marta_cs at 2025-04-11T09:32Z
cal_csm: I'll draft the mitigation ack and send to procurement. Keep this thread updated — if we don't have acceptance in 12h I'll escalate to GTM lead. :thumbsup:
